JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_PERK.title: Rally
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_PERK.description: If you do not have enough Energy to play this card, you may Exhaust cards from your [gold]Diary[/gold] equal to the missing Energy to play it.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COLLECTION.title: Keepsake
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COLLECTION.descript: At the start of combat, this card is added to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COUNTERATTACK.title: Counterattack
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COUNTERATTACK.descr:
Whenever you take damage (even [blue]0[/blue]), each [gold]Counterattack[/gold] card in your Hand, from left to right, creates and plays a copy of itself.
Triggers up to a number of times equal to its current cost each turn.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_STICKER.title: Sticker
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_STICKER.description:
Can be Upgraded any number of times.
Whenever your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] contains [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Sticker[/gold] cards with the same name and Upgrade level, remove them and add an Upgraded copy of that [gold]Sticker[/gold] card to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_TRANSCRIBE.title: Transcribe
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_TRANSCRIBE.descript:
After this card is played, add a [gold]copy[/gold] of it to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
Its following effect is active while this card is in your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECORD.title: Record
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECORD.description: After this card is played, if it is not [gold]Exhausted[/gold], add it to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECOLLECTION.title: Recollection
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECOLLECTION.descri: While in your [gold]Diary[/gold], after the following condition is met, its projection automatically appears in the [gold]Extra Hand[/gold] and can be played from your Diary. The condition resets after it is played.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.descrip: [gold]Inspiration[/gold] X: While this card is not in your [gold]Hand[/gold], right-click it and choose to [gold]Exhaust[/gold] X cards from your [gold]Diary[/gold] to add this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
